review_note: Editorial candidates. Official sources checked 2026-10-14. Availability and eligibility are never guaranteed.

resources.name: 211info
resources.audience: Anyone looking for a local referral
steps: Open 211info and search by your ZIP code or city.
Choose the category matching your need.
Contact the listed provider to check current availability; if you're stuck, call 211 and ask for a specialist.
resources.limitations: Referrals are not guaranteed openings, eligibility, or placement.

resources.name: Oregon Housing and Community Services
resources.audience: People needing rental or housing assistance
steps: Open the state housing help guide.
Find your county's Community Action Agency.
Contact the local agency about rental, shelter or utilities programs and what documents to prepare.
resources.limitations: OHCS does not directly provide emergency housing services. Funding and local eligibility vary.

resources.name: Oregon ONE benefits
resources.audience: People applying for food, medical, cash or childcare benefits
steps: Review medical, food, cash and childcare programs on the Oregon benefits website.
Apply online using ONE, by telephone, or at a local office.
Check the state checklist for information you may need and ask for application help if necessary.
resources.limitations: The state determines eligibility. Do not send personal documents to Auralethi.

resources.name: Aging and Disability Resource Connection
resources.audience: People seeking disability, aging, or long-term support resources
steps: Review the ADRC overview or call the statewide number.
Explain the support you need and your county; ask for an accessible format or accommodation if helpful.
Request contact details for the relevant local service and ask how to start an assessment.
resources.limitations: Programs and eligibility depend on the specific support requested.

resources.name: Oregon Health Plan
steps: Review the Oregon Health Plan eligibility and application page.
Apply through ONE or by calling the ONE Customer Service Center.
Ask the state how to submit requested documents and follow up on the application.
resources.limitations: Eligibility is determined by the state; coverage is not guaranteed.
